titulo: 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' scores second-biggest ever global opening weekend – nears $1bn worldwide
cuerpo: The recently released 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' has made box office history in its first weekend in cinemas and looks set to pass the $1bn mark in the next couple of days. It's on track to becoming the highest grossing movie of 2026, overtaking 'The Odyssey''s box office tally in just four days.
